title: Fascinating but there’s one problem
body: Your app is really helpful but there’s one problem that when I start a timer for a habit and then close the app the timer restarts again while it should resume the time session (e.g. I have created a “4 hours reading” habit and I put timer for 4 hours, when I read just 2 hours and come back later to complete my 4 hours reading habit by completing 2 hours more reading I have to set the timer again on 2 hours and start the session), I hope it’s clear. Thanks
